name: operations.account_strategies

list.description: List account operation strategies in the native default version view.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Native fundEntityList filter. Repeat for OR; dimensions combine with AND. Scope values are canonical sets.

parameters.name: bank
parameters.description: Native fundBankIdList filter. Repeat for OR; dimensions combine with AND. Scope values are canonical sets.

parameters.name: alias
parameters.description: Native aliasNameList filter. Repeat for OR; dimensions combine with AND. Scope values are canonical sets.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Native currencyList filter. Repeat for OR; dimensions combine with AND. Scope values are canonical sets.

parameters.name: account-type
parameters.description: Native accountTypeList filter. Repeat for OR; dimensions combine with AND. Scope values are canonical sets.

parameters.name: operation-strategy
parameters.description: Native operation strategy codes; exact known display-label members are checked without changing returned text. Repeat for OR.

parameters.name: cover-algorithm
parameters.description: Native coverAlgorithm Y/N filter; does not prove algorithm execution.

summary: Native account operation strategy configurations and versions.
purpose: Inspect complete native strategy records without selecting latest versions or approval states.

fields.name: version
fields.meaning: Native strategy version identity component, unchanged.

fields.name: operationStrategy
fields.meaning: Native comma-separated display labels, retaining order and duplicates.

fields.name: status
fields.meaning: Native configuration validity, distinct from approval status.

fields.name: processStatus
fields.meaning: Native approval state, not configuration validity.

fields.name: lastModifiedTime
fields.meaning: Native source time; timezone is not inferred.

identity_description: Typed native aliasName/currency/integer version tuple; no synthetic output ID.
limitations: Native default version view is not all history. Invalid records and all returned versions remain visible; no status/default approval filter or latest reducer.
Fixed qualified width5000 uses normal SDK offset/count/identity completeness. No separate terminal-empty query is performed or claimed.
Six optional native string-array filters use OR within dimensions and AND across dimensions; cover-algorithm is one Y/N value. No tenant, date or status request fields.
Unknown/nested fields and native amounts/timestamps remain unchanged in native arrival order. No related-source discovery or Get.
Bare offline List replays its saved native scope; explicit scope changes cannot broaden proven coverage and strict reads reject unproved scope.

sync.evidence: Typed native aliasName/currency/integer version tuple; no synthetic output ID. Complete acquisition uses the declared native List collector and its scope/completeness evidence.
